description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Tellah)] and [Earth Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Tellah)
description.text: Earth abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Earthquake after casting Earth abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Earth Mode II (Tellah)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Earth Mode II (Tellah)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Earth abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Earth abilities, grants [Instant Cast 1] to all allies after using Earth abilities, grants [Buff Earth 20% (5s)] to the user after using Earth abilities

description.name: Buff Earth 20% (5s)
description.text: Increases Earth damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3
